summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of IMORA Tchad. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases passing (100%) covering health, auth, properties CRUD with ownership checks, favorites, messages, payments, feedback (auth + anon), admin stats/users/properties/payments/feedback, and Claude-based AI chat. Frontend: home page renders with Chad flag stripe + logo + quick search + featured/recent sections; language switcher works (FR/EN/AR) and Arabic correctly sets dir=rtl/lang=ar; Search page filters render; Map page Leaflet renders cleanly (1 container, 24 tiles loaded) with no 'Map container is already initialized' error; Login page shows Google button; Property detail renders Leaflet map + contact buttons; Admin dashboard shows all stat cards (Users=3, Agencies=1, Annonces=1, Active sessions=3, Revenue=1000 XAF); AI Assistant FAB opens modal, sends message, and receives a substantive French reply that references real estate context and a real property [voir] link. No page errors during any flow.

issues: AI reply contains Markdown (** bold, ### headings, | tables, ` code) which is rendered as raw plain text. Only [property_id] tags are parsed. Add a markdown renderer (e.g., react-markdown) or instruct the system prompt to reply in plain text without markdown for readability.

design_issues.screen: AI FAB vs 'Made with Emergent' badge
issues: The Emergent badge sits at fixed bottom-right and can overlap with the AI FAB area on small viewports. FAB is at bottom-20 md:bottom-6 right-4 which is okay on desktop, but on very small screens an overlap of click-target zone with the badge is possible. Not a real bug for real users but consider increasing FAB margin on mobile.

action_items: (Optional polish) Render markdown in AI Assistant replies OR update system_msg to instruct Claude to reply in plain text (no **, no headings, no tables) — current output shows raw '**', '###', '|' to end users.
(Optional) Seed a verified/featured property so the 'Annonces en vedette' section on Home is non-empty for new visitors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/properties list: when both `q` and `min_area` are provided, the second `$or` assignment overwrites the first (both write to query['$or']). Combine with $and or merge filters to avoid silently dropping the area filter when a text query is also present.

server.py admin endpoints (PUT /admin/users/{id}, PUT /admin/properties/{id}/verify, PUT /admin/payments/{id}) accept raw `dict` body without Pydantic validation. Define typed update models for safety.
server.py @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handlers.
AIAssistant.jsx renders Claude markdown as plain text. Add markdown rendering or constrain system prompt to plain text.

server.py /api/properties/{id}/contact endpoint does not require auth and does not validate that the property exists — anonymous users can inflate contact_count arbitrarily. Consider rate-limit or existence check.

Properties pydantic 'photos: List[str]' will accept arbitrary length of base64 dataURLs (multi-MB). Add size validation (max bytes per photo, max count) to prevent OOM/MongoDB document-size overflow (16MB).
Backend logs not capturing AI chat failures distinctly — fallback message reveals technical error indirectly. Already wrapped in try/except, good.
test_credentials: Used Bearer tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: test_session_admin (admin), test_session_particulier (particulier), test_session_agence (agence). All present in DB and valid through 2026-06-20.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed properties/messages/payments/feedback via API and clean up properties after themselves. Some TEST_ messages/payments/feedback remain in DB by design (no public delete endpoints exposed). Profile fixture also updates particulier's phone/whatsapp to '+23566001122'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major flows verified end-to-end. If retesting: use Bearer test_session_admin/particulier/agence — they are pre-seeded. Pytest entry point is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (30 tests, ~28s runtime). Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://immobilier-tchad.preview.emergentagent.com. For AI FAB Playwright clicks, prefer fab.evaluate('el=>el.click()') to bypass the 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay (real users are unaffected). Admin route is /admin and requires cookie session_token=test_session_admin.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical issues. Only minor UX polish (markdown rendering) and a couple of small code-review items (overwritten $or filter, missing photo size validation, deprecated on_event). Backend AI chat correctly uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from /app/backend/.env.
